arts.name: Aikido
arts.description: Aikido is a modern Japanese martial art that emphasizes harmony and the redirection of an attacker's energy. Founded by Morihei Ueshiba in the early 20th century, it combines joint locks, throws, and pins with spiritual and philosophical principles. Practitioners learn to blend with an opponent's movements rather than meeting force with force.
arts.shortDescription: A Japanese martial art focused on harmony and redirecting energy
arts.philosophy: The way of harmonious spirit - emphasizing peace, non-resistance, and spiritual development

arts.name: Hatha Yoga
arts.description: Hatha Yoga is a traditional form of yoga that focuses on physical postures (asanas), breathing techniques (pranayama), and meditation. It serves as the foundation for most modern yoga styles and emphasizes the balance between body and mind. The practice aims to prepare the body for deeper spiritual practices while promoting overall health and well-being.
arts.shortDescription: Traditional yoga focusing on postures, breathing, and meditation
arts.philosophy: Union of body, mind, and spirit through physical and mental discipline

arts.name: Pottery
arts.description: Pottery is the ancient art of shaping clay into functional or decorative objects and firing them at high temperatures to create durable ceramics. This craft combines technical skill with artistic expression, allowing practitioners to create everything from simple bowls to intricate sculptures. The process involves centering clay on a wheel, shaping it with hands and tools, drying, glazing, and firing in a kiln.
arts.shortDescription: The art of creating ceramic objects from clay
arts.origin: Ancient civilizations worldwide, dating back 20,000+ years
arts.philosophy: Transforming earth into art through patience, skill, and fire

arts.name: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
arts.description: Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) is a martial art and combat sport that focuses on ground fighting and submission holds. Developed from Japanese Jujutsu and Judo, BJJ emphasizes technique and leverage over strength, allowing smaller practitioners to defend against larger opponents. The art teaches practitioners to take the fight to the ground and use various chokes, joint locks, and positional control to subdue opponents.
arts.shortDescription: Ground-fighting martial art emphasizing technique over strength
arts.origin: Brazil, early 20th century (derived from Japanese Jujutsu)
arts.philosophy: The gentle art - using technique and leverage to overcome size and strength

arts.name: Woodworking
arts.description: Woodworking is the craft of creating objects from wood using various tools and techniques. From furniture making to fine carpentry, woodworking combines technical skill with artistic vision. Practitioners learn to select appropriate woods, use hand and power tools safely, understand joinery techniques, and apply finishes. The craft ranges from simple projects to complex furniture and architectural elements.
arts.shortDescription: The craft of creating functional and artistic objects from wood
arts.origin: Ancient craft practiced worldwide for millennia
arts.philosophy: Respecting the material and bringing out the natural beauty of wood
